title: Approval for Subletting of HDB Flats within Minimum Occupation Period
what_it_is: Approval for Subletting of HDB Flats within Minimum Occupation Period

sections.label: Subletting approvals within MOP
sections.summary: Approvals to sublet within the MOP are for one or two years, and owners must make up the subletting period to fulfil the MOP.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Each approval to sublet within the MOP is for short periods of one or two years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: And when these flat owners reoccupy the flat, they will have to make up for the period of subletting to fulfil the MOP.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Over the last three years, HDB granted an average of 785 approvals each year to flat owners to sublet their flats within the MOP and this is about 2% of the total subletting approvals each year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Of these approved cases for subletting, an average of about 110 cases were granted an extension each year.

sections.label: Reasons for subletting approval
sections.summary: HDB most commonly allows subletting within the MOP for overseas work, and also considers family or compassionate reasons case-by-case.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: In fact, the most common reason for allowing is for work overseas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: That is usually the most common reason why HDB would agree to a request to subletting within the MOP period, that means, the person having bought an HDB flat, for some reason, employers request them to work overseas and then that is a valid reason.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: There may be other reasons like family circumstances, parents or somebody who has fallen sick for extended periods of time, a resident would appeal on a sympathetic or compassionate basis to want to move to take care of an elderly father or mother and would like to do that for a year or so.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, there could be various other reasons like these.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: And, like I said, we will look at it case-by-case and, if it is valid, HDB would want to support and provide room and leeway for the residents to be able to do so, on the condition, as I have said, that they would then have to make up for that period after they return to their flat.
